name: Decision Signal Router
acceptance_criteria: routes a validated change signal only to active watches in the exact company and decision-subject scope
matches equal field paths and parent/child dot-path changes without substring collisions
returns review_required and no requests when changed-field metadata is missing
deduplicates repeated identical watch-index rows and rejects conflicting duplicate rows
returns deterministic watch ordering and stable per-signal/per-watch idempotency hints
returns only Step 26 event-cycle request fields plus source correlation metadata
does not load evidence, evaluate conditions, persist, enqueue, notify, or execute

verification.note: Signal routing acceptance tests passed after the archive integration pass.

host_owned_components: transport bridge, source validation, and field normalization
